Module: Note (GAP-EXM-01): ExamService.mapToAttemptDTO reads attempt.answersJson back via objectMapper.readValue(answersJson, Map.class) — but ExamService.saveExamAttempt actually persists answersJson as a JSON ARRAY (via enrichAnswers, which returns List<Map<String,Object>>). Reading an array as a Map throws MismatchedInputException internally, caught by a broad catch, silently defaulting to an empty answers map. Net effect: getExamAttempts, getMyExamAttempts, and the saveExamAttempt response ALWAYS return an empty 'answers' field to the API caller, even though the enriched per-question answer data (userAnswer/isCorrect/skill/topic) is correctly persisted in the database. This looks like an unintentional bug (the array vs Map type mismatch), not a documented design choice — worth flagging to dev. Not fixed this round; test asserts current (buggy) behavior per code-first principle. Re-verified 2026-07-24, still reproduces.

Note (GAP-EXM-02): ExamService.getAllExams(status) — when a non-null, non-'All' status other than 'PUBLISHED' is passed, the method queries the DB for rows matching that status, then immediately filters the result to keep only status=='PUBLISHED', which can never match. Net effect: this parameter path always returns an empty list for any status value other than 'PUBLISHED'/null/'All'. Likely dead/broken filter logic — no current caller appears to rely on it (learner-facing exam browsing only ever wants PUBLISHED), but flagging since it's a real inconsistency in the code. Re-verified 2026-07-24, still reproduces.

Note (GAP-EXM-03 — RE-VERIFIED 2026-07-24, NO LONGER REPRODUCES): earlier plan assumed saveExamAttempt persisted request.getScore() as-is with no server-side recomputation or 0-10 range validation. Current code does NOT do this: attempt.setScore(calculatedScore) always uses a score computed server-side as 10*correctCount/examQuestions.size() (see enrichAnswers/toAnswerRecord), and request.getScore() is never read anywhere in saveExamAttempt. When no answers are supplied, score defaults to BigDecimal.ZERO regardless of any client-supplied score value (see saveExamAttemptShouldDefaultScoreToZeroWhenNoAnswersProvided, UTC03 above). No client-score-injection or missing-range-validation gap exists in the current implementation — this note is retained for history only and superseded by the corrected UTC03 row above.
